from pytimeparse2 import parse

pairs = [
    ("clock", parse("1:02:03:04")),
    ("words", parse("1d2h3m4s")),
    ("bad", parse("garbage")),
    ("signed", parse("- 1 minute")),
]
normalized = []
for name, value in pairs:
    if value is None:
        normalized.append((name, "NONE"))
    elif value < 0:
        normalized.append((name, abs(value)))
    else:
        normalized.append((name, value))

print(pairs)
print(normalized)
print(normalized[0][1] == normalized[1][1])
